final: WITH s AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS cnt FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s), sh AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.cnt, CAST(s.cnt AS REAL)/t.total AS share, (SELECT AVG(CAST(s2.cnt AS REAL)/t.total) FROM s s2) AS avgshare FROM s, t) SELECT zoneref, cnt AS feature_count, share, share - avgshare AS margin_above_avg FROM sh WHERE share > avgshare ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
